recommendation: Observed downside continuation and lower-range holding keep the mapped policy state in strong-block territory; de-escalation depends on sustained repair rather than event importance alone.
headline: NQ remains in a high-Tail downtrend as the U.S. cash open stays weak and Brent trades above $100
body: Available delayed NQ references place September futures near the lower session range after a roughly 300-point high-to-low decline, while the U.S. cash Nasdaq opened lower. Brent is above $100 and the 10-year Treasury yield is near 4.8%; current NQ data remain delayed, limiting microstructure certainty.

forecast.analysis: By 16:00 UTC, meaningful recovery from the lower range would reduce Tail to elevated. Continued failed repair would keep the downside regime dominant into the next catalyst window.

Apple's 17:00 UTC event is a concentration checkpoint. Elevated Tail assumes only conditional index-wide follow-through; an isolated Apple reaction without broader Nasdaq alignment would not justify a high Tail state.
In the first post-Apple hour, Tail remains elevated only if any event reaction broadens through major technology names and NQ fails to retrace. Two-way price discovery would favor de-escalation.

Late-session risk stays elevated if the earlier downside structure reasserts after a failed recovery. Stable breadth and deeper retracements would reduce the probability of persistent one-way continuation.
Approaching power hour, elevated Tail reflects residual continuation risk from the day's trend. A balanced range and repeated successful pullbacks would push the state toward WATCH.
During the cash-close transition, WATCH is the base case if the session develops more two-way trade. A renewed drive to fresh lows with shallow repair would be the condition for re-escalation.

Early Globex liquidity can magnify headline-driven moves. WATCH persists because Middle East and oil risk remain active, while a lack of directional follow-through would keep Tail below blocking levels.
Through the early evening futures session, the expected path is WATCH unless geopolitical headlines create a new directional gap or the prior U.S. trend resumes without meaningful retracement.
As Asian liquidity begins to build, WATCH remains conditional on whether the U.S. downside leg carries forward. Stable oil and balanced index futures would favor further repair.
Deeper into Asia, Tail is near the lower edge of WATCH. A contained range would support normalization, while renewed oil escalation paired with index extension would reverse that improvement.
Overnight risk stays at WATCH because the macro backdrop remains stressed even if directional efficiency fades. New lows without repair would be the key condition for escalation.
The pre-Europe overnight window remains WATCH. With no scheduled U.S. Tier-1 release in this hour, Tail depends mainly on whether the prior trend persists or mean reversion continues to work.
Near the European handoff, Tail edges higher within WATCH because liquidity and cross-asset participation increase. Confirmation from yields and oil would matter only alongside renewed NQ extension.
At the European open, WATCH reflects the possibility that the prior U.S. trend is reinforced. A two-way European session would keep Tail below the blocking threshold despite elevated macro Stress.
European morning trading remains a conditional WATCH window. Persistent lower highs and failed rebounds would raise path risk; broader stabilization would keep the regime mixed.
With Europe fully active, WATCH remains tied to continuation quality rather than event importance. Directional breadth without NQ extension would be insufficient by itself to raise Tail.
Mid-European morning risk eases slightly if price discovery stays balanced. Renewed session-low pressure combined with higher yields or oil would be the principal re-escalation condition.
Late European morning remains WATCH with no automatic block. The key distinction is whether any directional move develops repeated extension after failed retracements.
By 10:00 UTC, attention begins shifting toward the U.S. inflation sequence. Tail remains WATCH because scheduled data alone do not establish a pathological price path.
At 11:00 UTC, PPI is approaching but has not printed. Tail stays below the blocking threshold unless independent live structure is already showing one-way extension and failed repair.
The 12:00 UTC slot contains the 12:30 UTC PPI release. WATCH reflects event-path risk, not an assumed result; escalation requires the actual post-release NQ path to become persistently directional.
In the first full post-PPI hour, WATCH remains the base forecast unless verified price discovery shows sustained extension, shallow retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecastDetail.comment: Cash-open weakness extends the observed downtrend; delayed NQ remains near the lower range and Tail is high.
High Tail persists conditionally if opening weakness holds with shallow repair; deeper recovery would de-escalate.
Meaningful repair would reduce Tail to elevated; failed repair would keep downside persistence relevant.
Apple is a concentration checkpoint, but elevated Tail requires broader Nasdaq follow-through rather than an isolated move.
Post-event Tail stays elevated only with broad directional confirmation and failed retracement.
Late-session Tail remains elevated if the earlier downtrend reasserts after a failed recovery.
